title: Declared sample
purpose: Add or edit one sample’s collection details, intended tests and grouped containers before laboratory review.
summary: One declared sample in your submission: how and where it was collected, the tests you intend, and the containers you are sending.

tasks.title: Declare a sample
steps: Enter [[Your sample ID]], the [[Matrix]], [[Collector name]] and [[Collection location]].
Choose the [[Intended tests]]; only tests for the sample's matrix can be added.
Add each container type with its [[Quantity]], then select [[Add sample]].

tasks.title: Declare several similar samples quickly
steps: Select [[Save and add another]]. The next sample is copied from this one, with the sample ID blank.
Check every copied value, especially times and location, before saving it.

tasks.title: Prepare bottles before sampling
steps: Leave [[Collected / composite ended at]] blank and set a [[Planned collection date]] instead.
Never enter an estimated future time; the actual time is confirmed at receipt.

good_to_know: Your sample ID must be unique within the submission. It is used on planned labels and to match the received sample.
Changing the matrix keeps the chosen tests for review. Remove the ones that no longer match before saving.
Mark field blanks, trip blanks and field duplicates in Sample type. The laboratory confirms it at receipt.
A submission holds up to 200 samples, and each sample up to 20 containers.
If the submission changed after you opened the form, saving is refused but your typing is kept. Reload and review.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Sign in with an active client account. Every page, selection and action is limited to the client attached to your account, including work created by other users for the same client. Staff accounts cannot use these portal pages. Another client’s record is treated as missing.

sections.title: Eligibility and defaults
paragraphs: The parent submission must be Draft or Returned for changes. Submitted, Accepted and Cancelled declarations cannot be edited. Up to 200 samples are allowed per submission. Edits replace the current declaration; earlier submitted snapshots stay frozen.

A normal new sample starts with Grab, Field sample and quantity 1. Save and add another opens a new sample copied from the one just saved, including sample type, matrix, sample source, times/planned date, collector, location, field notes, intended tests and container groups, but clears Your sample ID. Every copied value remains editable; check it for the next sample. Editing opens that sample’s current values. Times use laboratory local time.

items.label: Your sample ID
items.description: Required identifier up to 120 characters; must be unique within this submission without regard to letter case. Used on planned labels and to match the received sample.

items.label: Sample type
items.description: List: Field sample (initially), Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank. Mark field blanks, trip blanks and field duplicates. The laboratory confirms it at receipt.

items.label: Collection type
items.description: Required Grab or Composite; initially Grab.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Required Water, Wastewater or Soil; intended tests must match.

items.label: Sample source
items.description: Optional list grouped by matrix, with Not stated first. Water: Drinking water, Groundwater, Surface water, Stormwater. Wastewater: Wastewater influent, Wastewater effluent, Industrial wastewater, Stormwater. Soil: Soil, Sediment, Sludge / biosolids, Solid waste. What was sampled. It must belong to the matrix; otherwise the form refuses it (the message names the matrix) and nothing is saved.

items.label: Collector name
items.description: Required collector identity, up to 160 characters, even for planned samples.

items.label: Collection started at
items.description: Composites only. Required if an actual composite end is entered; start cannot follow end. A start without any end is refused. Grab saves clear a supplied start time.

items.label: Collected / composite ended at
items.description: Optional actual collection/end timestamp. Leave blank when preparing bottles before collection; never enter an estimated future time. A real time cannot be in the future. Actual time is required later at laboratory receipt.

items.label: Planned collection date
items.description: Optional date used only while actual collection time is blank. Saving an actual collection time clears this planned date. It is not treated as an observed collection or holding-time start.

items.label: Collection location
items.description: Required specific place, up to 200 characters.

items.label: Field notes
items.description: Optional field readings or conditions for the laboratory; carried into submitted history and displayed to receiving staff. At receipt they prefill the Sample remarks field.

items.label: Intended tests
items.description: Choose at least one active test on an active method for the sample matrix. Labels identify analyte, method code/version, result unit and matrix. These are intended requests; the laboratory confirms actual tests at receipt.

items.label: Search analyte, method or unit
items.description: Enhanced picker searches analyte, method code/version and unit, with no result cap. Only matching-matrix tests can be added. Enter adds the highlighted choice, Backspace removes the last choice and Left arrow moves to earlier choices.

items.label: Remove test / Remove this test / Remove these tests
items.description: Remove an individual choice or all highlighted matrix mismatches. Changing matrix keeps existing selections for review; remove mismatches or correct the matrix before saving. Errors preserve selections. Without enhancement, use the native multiple-select.

items.label: Container type 1, 2, …
items.description: Each group is one container type. Group identical bottles into one row; these are planned declarations, not verified receipt conditions.

items.label: Container type
items.description: Required list: Select…, ten common vial, bottle and jar types (for example 40 mL VOA vial, 1 L plastic (HDPE), 1 L amber glass, 8 oz glass jar) or Other…. Other… reveals a text box (Describe) whose text is stored, up to 160 characters. The list is a starter vocabulary, not a method requirement.

items.label: Preservative
items.description: Optional list, Not recorded first: None, HNO3 (nitric acid), H2SO4 (sulfuric acid), HCl (hydrochloric acid), NaOH (sodium hydroxide), Zinc acetate + NaOH, Na2S2O3 (sodium thiosulfate), NaHSO4 (sodium bisulfate), Methanol, Ascorbic acid or Other… (your own text, up to 200 characters). What was added to the container in the field. Does not record a laboratory preservation check.

items.label: Quantity
items.description: Required whole number from 1 to 20, initially 1. Total quantity over retained types cannot exceed 20.

items.label: Remove this container type
items.description: Exclude this entire type and its quantity when saving.

items.label: Add container type
items.description: Append a type when JavaScript is available. At least one complete retained type is required. Up to 20 form rows and 20 total individual containers are allowed; unchanged spare rows are ignored.

items.label: Add sample / Save changes
items.description: Validate and save this sample in the current declaration, then return to submission detail. Does not submit, collect, receive or create laboratory sample IDs.

items.label: Save and add another
items.description: Save this sample and open a new sample with its values copied and sample ID blank. The same submission limits and validations apply.

items.label: Cancel / submission number / Submissions
items.description: Leave without saving and return to the related record or list.

items.label: Changed submission
items.description: Any change to submission contents after opening can make this form stale. The save is refused and typed input is retained; reload and review current details before trying again.

items.label: Required fields and errors
items.description: Asterisks mark required fields. Errors appear beside fields or above the form; entered values stay available for correction after validation fails. A stale-record error requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: When this form opens in a dialog, change its size without saving. Small screens already use the full screen.

items.label: Close form / Cancel
items.description: Leave without saving. If the dialog detects edits, Keep editing returns to the form and Discard changes leaves without saving.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Retry if loading the dialog failed. During saving, wait for the request to finish; the submit button indicates work is running.
